items.text: Kotema EJAKAIT Musa ka Aaron atiar,
“Kimarasi odwe luka Kokat kotoma odwe luka Lebi, kwape ejaatar ikekiakec, kwape cjaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee.
Ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany, kere luekapakina aiiaanakin, aswam kotoma owema loka airiamunun,
Na ŋes aswam naka odwe luka Kokat kotoma owema loka airiamunun, koboro lukalaunak eut;
Naitobwosere idukurun, elomari Aaron ka odweke toma, elaeunete aigalisit naetiakit, erapakiniata ŋes asaduku naka aitejenunet.
kujuke, ido eburiarete kere kegoe lobululu, irupakinete adaketake,
Epesikinete egoe lobululu omesa loka imugatin luka aitodikin, idokokinete nen atuba ka akaalei ka atanya, ka aikopon nubukununet: ejaunete nen da imugatin ludue:
Ido erapiarete kere kegoe lokarenan, eburiarete bobo kemukule loka etakas, irupakinete da adaketake.
Elemunete egoe lobululu, aimukoria epir loka atala naka aica, ka atalaike, ka aridetake, ka aitudeŋetake, ka itidoike luka akinyet luetwasamaete kesi aiiaanakinia:
Eburiarete ŋes ka itidoike kere kemukule loka etakas, idokokinete adaketeke.
Epesikinete egoe lobululu otem loka esabu, iburiarete bobo kemukule loka etakas, irupakinete da adaketake:
Ibwaikinete iboro kere luetwasamaete aiiaanakinia, luejaanakiniata kotoma aibois nakalaunan, toma ogoe lobululu, eburiarete da kere kemukule loka etakas, idokokinete da adaketeke,
Emudarete ekurwon kotoma otem, epesikinete egoe lomuge:

Idokokinete nen iboroke kere, lueiaanakiniata ŋes, ieuman luka akim, ka igoluna luka akiriŋ, ka amudeta, ka atanyia, iboro kere luka etem; epesikinete da eimukoret loka emukule loka etakas, irupakinete da adaketake.

Kedaut Aaron ka odweke arapakin aibois nakalauian ka iboro kere lukotoma aibois nakalaunan, naedolio aitobwot iidukurun; akaulo kanun, epote odwe luka Kokat aidak ŋes: konye mam kes etirorete iboro lukalaunak kinyeis atwakare. Iboro ŋul kes luedakete odwe luka Kokat luka ewema loka airiamunun.

Ido luidari Eleasar okoku loka Aaron esasedoti kes lu, akinyet naka atala, ka lukisupurununo, ka ainakinet nadue naka akiria, ka akinyet nakinyonyoanakina, idari da ewema lokalaunan ka lueja toma kere, aibois nakalaunan ka iboroke da.”
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa ka Aaron atiar,
“Sirikitiakasi ateker naka ikekia luka Ikokatin kotoma oLebin:
Konye kiswamak kes kwana, tetere eiarere kinyeis atwakare, kikunyakis neejaas iboro lukalaunak noi: elomari Aaron ka odweke toma, kosodete aitodianakin kes ninitunanan akeswam ka ibore yenedaki:
Konye mam elomarete toma aanyun iboro lukalaunak, nepeeep da, kinyeis atwakare.”
“Kimar odwe luka Gereson da, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee, kwape ejaatar ikekiakee;
Imari kes ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany; kere luekapakina aijaanakin, aswam. Kotoma owema loka airiamunun,
Na ŋes aswam naka ikekia luka Igeresonin, naiiaanakiniata naedakiata da iboro:
Edakete kesi aigalisio nuka ewema lokalaunan, ka ewema loka airiamunun, eimukoreteke, ka eimukoret loka emukule loka etakas loejai kujuke, ka aigalisit naka ekek loka ewema loka airiamunun;

Ka luikaiai alaro, ka aigalisit naka ekek loka erute loka alaro, naidunyas kewema lokalaunan, naidunyas da ketem kolukunite, ka aunoikee, ka iboro kere da lueupatar kaiiaanakinikec, kere nuibusakinit aiswamakin kes, nupenun ijaanakinete.
Kwape icorakinia Aaron ka odweke kwaŋin ijaanakiniata odwe luka Igeresonin, kotoma kaluedakete kere, kotoma kaluiiaanakinete da; itodikinete kes luedakete kere.
Ŋin ŋes aswam naka ikekia luka odwe luka Igeresonin kotoma owema loka airiamunun: idarete kesi koanyanari Itamar okoku loka Aaron esasedoti.
Ka odwe luka Merari da, imari ijo kes kwape ejaatar ikekiakee, kwape ejaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakee;
Imari kes ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany, ninitunanan yenekapakina aijaanakin, aswam kotoma owema loka airiamunun,
Lu kes iboro luidarete kesi, kwape eiaar aswamukee kotoma owema loka airiamunun; abaoi nuka ewema lokalaunan, ka akitoke nukirionokina, ka ipirinoke ka aigaŋetakec;
Ka ipirino luka alaro naelukunit, ka aigaŋetakec, ka ikeceloin, ka aunoikee, ka iborokec kere lueupatar, ka luijaanakiniata; ibilete ikiroria luka iboro kere luidarete kesi ka luedakete,
Ŋin ŋes aswam naka ikekia luka odwe luka Merari, kwape eiaar aijaanakinikec kere kotoma owema loka airiamunun, koanyanari Itamar okoku loka Aaron esasedoti.”
Kimarata Musa ka Aaron ka ikapolok luka ekodet odwe luka Ikokatin kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, kwape ajaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec,
Ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany, ninitunanan yenekapakina aijaanakin, aswam kotoma owema loka airiamunun.
Ŋul da luaponi kimarai kakesi kwape ajaatar ikekiakec emwaasi ilukumin iarei ka akwat akanykaarei ka akaisakany.
Ŋul kes luaponi kimarai luka ikekia luka Ikokatin, kere luapotu kiiaanakis kotoma owema loka airiamunun, luemarete Musa ka Aaron kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT kama ka Musa.
Ka nul da luaponi kimarai luka odwe luka Gereson, kwape ajaatar ikekiakee, kwape ajaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec,
Ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany, ninitunanan yenekapakina aijaanakin, aswam kotoma owema loka airiamunun.
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, kwape ajaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec, emwaasi ilukumin iarei ka akwat akanykape ka akaisauni.
Ŋul kes luaponi kimarai luka ikekia luka odwe luka Gereson, kere luapotu kijaanakis kotoma owema loka airiamunun, luemarete Musa ka Aaron kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT.
Ka ŋul da luaponi kimarai luka ikekia luka odwe luka Merari, kwape ajaatar ikekiakee, kwape ajaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec.
Ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany, ninitunanan yenekapakina aijaanakin, aswam kotoma owema loka airiamunun.
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, emwaasi ilukumin iuni ka akwat aarei.
Ŋul kes luaponi kimarai luka ikekia luka odwe luka Merari, luemarete Musa ka Aaron kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT, kama ka Musa.
Ŋul kere luaponi kimarai luka Ilebin, luemarete Musa ka Aaron ka ikapolok luka Isirael kwape ajaatar ikekiakec, kwape ajaatar ikalia luka lukapapaakec.
Ageun kaluka ikar akaisauni ka luedeparito aitodol luka ikar akaisakany, ŋinituŋanan yenekapakina aswam naka aijaanakin, ka aswam naka aidak iboro kotoma owema loka airiamunun,
Ŋul luaponi kimarai kakesi, emwaasi ilukumin ikanykauni ka akwat akany ka akaisakanykauni.
Kwape ajaar aicorakinet naka EJAKAIT aponi kimarai kes kama ka Musa, ŋinituŋanan kwape ajaar aijaanakinike, ido kwape ajaar aidakake: kwaŋin aponi kimarai, kwape kicorakinia EJAKAIT Musa.
